title: عيدُ اتِّحادِ بِلادي
title_note: اعرض الصورة واسأل: ماذا ترون؟ بماذا تذكّركم؟
objective: I can talk about the UAE Union Day celebrations, use past and present verbs, and write a greeting card.
criteria: I can listen to the song and write the colours I hear.
I can draw my country's flag and talk about my country.
I can read the dialogue and say how countries celebrate their national day.
I can write a greeting card for a friend's national day.
